Subject: SkyBridge - Security questionnaire & evidence handoff planning

Hi Sean and Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. SkyBridge is preparing a SIG/CAIQ submission for our vendor risk team and we'd like to schedule an intake call to align on evidence handoff and traceability. Our review deadline is Dec 15, so getting the evidence inventory and owners identified this week would be ideal.

High-level asks for the call:
- Confirm the list of questionnaires you can accept (SIG, CAIQ v3.1, SOC 2 checklist).
- Walk through your preferred evidence format and minimal metadata (control id, timeframe, data owner).
- Discuss secure upload options and retention expectations.
- Identify Redwood contacts for each control family for follow-ups.

Proposed slots (PST): Tue 11/30 11:00-11:30, Wed 12/1 10:00-10:30, Wed 12/1 16:00-16:30. We prefer the first two.

Attaching a small CAIQ export and a list of our internal owners for the call.

Attachments: SkyBridge_CAiq-export.json (14 KB)

Thanks,
Alex Nguyen
Senior Security Program Manager
SkyBridge Systems
alex.nguyen@skybridge.com

Alex —

Thanks for the details and the quick CAIQ export, very helpful. We can take SIG, CAIQ v3.1, and SOC 2 evidence sets. Happy to cover the evidence format and metadata in the intake call.

Wed 12/1 10:00 PST works best for our team. Marissa (Security Ops) will lead intake and I'll join to cover deployment and runtime questions. Monica (CS) will own the upload logistics and access provisioning.

Before the call can you confirm:
- A point person for each control family (you sent a list but please confirm contact emails).
- Any controls that require encrypted artifacts or contact with a technical owner (e.g., keys/KMS).
- Whether you need us to accept artifacts via S3 presigned links or a secure SharePoint drop.

We'll use the attached template during the call to capture evidence owners; after the call we'll populate and share a single evidence log.

Proposed agenda (20 min):
1) Quick intros (3 min)
2) Evidence format & metadata (7 min)
3) Upload options and access (5 min)
4) Action items & owners (5 min)

See you Wednesday.

—Sean

Subject: Notes: Intake call (SkyBridge) — evidence owners & next steps

Hi all —

Thanks for taking the call. Below are concise notes and agreed actions (minutes from the 12/01/2026 10:00 PST intake):

Attendees:
- Alex Nguyen (SkyBridge)
- Dan Kim (SkyBridge)
- Sean Gallagher (Redwood)
- Marissa Cole (Redwood)

Summary:
- Redwood accepts SIG and CAIQ v3.1 exports and will map items to our internal control inventory.
- Evidence template: we used the redwood_evidence_template.xlsx to capture control_id, artifact_name, owner, retention period, link, and notes.
- Upload channel: presigned S3 links preferred for artifacts >5 MB; smaller files to security@skybridge.com.
- Encrypted KMS exports: Dan will coordinate with our infra team; Redwood will provide a one-time upload bucket.
- Timeline: Aim to complete initial evidence ingestion by Dec 7 to allow Redwood time to produce the vendor report before your Dec 15 review.

3) Marissa Cole (Redwood) — populate evidence template with initial control mapping and share (Due: 2026-12-02)
4) Monica Patel (Redwood) — create upload bucket and send instructions + permissions guide (Due: 2026-12-03)

Subject: Re: SkyBridge - Security questionnaire & evidence handoff planning — upload details

Alex / Dan —

We created the temporary S3 bucket and upload instructions. Please find the short checklist below and a link to the evidence template we populated. If you prefer a different path, let us know.

Upload checklist:
- Use the presigned link for each artifact (expiry 7 days).
- Name artifacts using: SBX_{controlID}_{artifact_shortname}_{YYYYMM}.pdf
- Include a single CSV row per artifact in the redwood_evidence_template.xlsx with owner and timeframe.
- For KMS exports, put a small manifest file (manifest_KMS_{controlID}.json) in the bucket and email security@redwood.com; we will reach out for a secured transfer.

Shared items: https://redwood.sharepoint.com/sites/SIG/DB-9843-evidence/redwood_evidence_template.xlsx
Presigned upload link (one-time): https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-temp-uploads/put?X-Amz-SignedHeaders=... (expires 2026-12-09)

Attachments: redwood_evidence_template.xlsx (attached for convenience)

We'll mark items as received in the evidence log and ping owners for any clarifications. Thanks for the quick turnaround on your side.

—Sean
